Oleksandr Baranov — Alex Sharp

Automotive and industrial designer

A car should move people through possibility

I design where sustainable energy, radical aerodynamics and emotional form meet.

Within the Free Energy / VoltMobiles universe I develop electric grand tourers and performance concepts.

Exterior design
Concept vehicles, silhouette, surface language

Industrial design

We don’t wait for the future. We are the future.

  • Design must inspire, and ours does.
  • We pursue perfection not only in aesthetics but in aerodynamics.
  • Every line of our concepts is pure energy shaped into form.
  • Wave resonance and innovative platforms erase the line between machine and space.
  • We reject compromise, choosing bold engineering and flawless style.
  • Our goal is not just to move through space, but to command the very possibility of speed.

Free Energy
